title: Anatomy-Informed Neural Networks: Encoding Anatomic Priors in Loss and Architecture, with an SE(3) Formulation of Guidewire-Induced Aortoiliac Deformation
abstract: arXiv:2608.21332v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep-learning models of anatomy can be numerically plausible yet anatomically impossible, and they generalize poorly when data are scarce. We introduce Anatomy-Informed Neural Networks (AINN), in which soft anatomic priors enter as penalty terms in the loss (e.g., a branching penalty that treats a renal transplant artery off the iliac instead of the aorta as unexpected rather than impossible), in direct analogy to a physics-informed neural network, and hard anatomic priors (e.g., continuity of the vessel) are built into the architecture and state representation, making such invalid predictions impossible by construction wherever the prior admits architectural enforcement.   We develop it on a clinical test case with limited data: how the aortoiliac tree deforms when a stiff wire is introduced endoluminally. translated_title: 解剖信息神经网络：在损失与架构中编码解剖先验，并包含导丝诱导的主动脉髂动脉变形的SE(3)公式化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21332v1 公告类型：新 摘要：解剖学的深度学习模型在数值上可能合理，但在解剖学上却不可能，并且在数据稀缺时泛化能力差。我们引入了解剖信息神经网络（AINN），其中软性解剖先验作为损失中的惩罚项（例如，一个分支惩罚将肾移植动脉从髂动脉而非主动脉发出的情况视为意外而非不可能），这直接类比于物理信息神经网络；而硬性解剖先验（例如，血管的连续性）则被构建到架构和状态表示中，使得在先验允许架构强制执行的任何地方，这类无效预测在构造上就不可能发生。我们在一个数据有限的临床测试案例上开发了该方法：当一根硬导丝被腔内引入时，主动脉髂动脉树如何变形。这对当代主动脉手术很重要，并将影响自主血管内导航。我们将血管中心线提升到...
tldr: 本文提出解剖信息神经网络（AINN），通过将软性解剖先验作为损失惩罚项和硬性解剖先验嵌入架构，确保解剖学上不可能的预测在构造上被禁止，并在导丝诱导的主动脉髂动脉变形这一数据稀缺的临床案例中验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Anatomy-Informed Neural Networks (AINN), which encode soft anatomic priors as loss penalties and hard priors into the architecture to make anatomically impossible predictions impossible by construction, demonstrated on a data-limited clinical case of guidewire-induced aortoiliac deformation.
